name: PCSX2 (PS2 emulator)
notice: PCSX2 v2.8.2 official portable release, unmodified, run only as a separate process. It needs a PS2 BIOS dump that you supply yourself; Rensga never ships or downloads one. Windows: install it yourself (see the host note); Rensga does not repack it.

windows-x86_64.note: Download the portable pcsx2-v2.8.2-windows-x64-Qt.7z from https://github.com/PCSX2/pcsx2/releases/tag/v2.8.2, unpack it anywhere and point the editor (or ~/.config/rensga/emulators.json pcsx2.exe) at pcsx2-qt.exe.
